subject: BridgeNet connector — escalation: production latency regression & remediation commitment
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Trevor Miles <trevor@bridgenet.io>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BridgeNet connector — production latency regression (initial escalation)

Trevor,

Heads up — since the 2026-08-29 connector release (v2.4.1) our DC-west customers are seeing a sustained 3x increase in tail latency for calls proxied through BridgeNet. This started ~22:00 UTC on 2026-08-29 and affects both generation and embeddings routes for customer accounts using the BridgeNet adapter.

We pulled logs and attached an incident snippet (bridgenet_incident_log_20260830.txt). Impact summary:
- Error rate: +1.8% 5xx across the proxy (-about 2.1% of user requests impacted)
- Tail p95 latency: from ~120ms -> ~380ms for proxied requests
- A subset of customers have experienced timeouts and partial responses

This is an operational/regression risk for multiple high-value customers (see RED-9123). We need a partner-side commitment on an escalation path and a remediation timeline. Proposed asks:
1) Acknowledgement within 2 hours of receipt with an assigned BridgeNet escalation lead.
2) A triage call within 4 hours with engineering on both sides (we can host).
3) Target hotfix/mitigation within 24 hours or a rollback to v2.4.0 if root cause isn’t found.

I attached a short mutual action plan draft (redwood-bridgenet-mutual-action-plan-20260830.pdf) — please review and confirm. If BridgeNet prefers an alternate cadence / SLA, state it explicitly so we can align with our CS and affected customers.

Thanks — this is high priority.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0134

From: Trevor Miles <trevor@bridgenet.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: support@bridgenet.io, Anika Voss <anika.voss@modulus.consulting>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BridgeNet connector — production latency regression (initial escalation)

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick escalation and the logs. We’ve triaged on-call and are seeing the same elevated tail latencies in our proxy logs correlating with the v2.4.1 handshake timing path. I’m assigning our escalation lead, Anika Voss (cc’d).

Immediate plan:
- Ack and lead assigned: Trevor / Anika (within 1 hour).
- Triage call: 2026-08-30 13:00 UTC (I know this is ~3 hours from now; if that works, please send calendar invite).
- Short-term mitigation: toggle the new connection pooling heuristic to the prior setting (we can push a configuration toggle within 2 hours) — this is our preferred fast rollback step over a full connector downgrade.
- If mitigation fails, we’ll coordinate an ordered rollback to v2.4.0 and test with your staging before production rollback (target <24 hours).

We’ll join the triage call with two engineers and a SRE. I’ll confirm the meeting invite in the next 15m.

Apologies for the disruption — we’ll treat this as P1 and keep you updated in the thread.

— Trevor
Trevor Miles | Head of Integrations | BridgeNet
trevor@bridgenet.io | +1 (206) 555-0148

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Trevor Miles <trevor@bridgenet.io>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BridgeNet connector — production latency regression (initial escalation)

Thanks Trevor — appreciate the quick turnaround. Calendar invite received and accepted for 13:00 UTC; Jordan will lead the call from our side.

For the call agenda and MOP (mutual action plan) please review the draft in Drive (link below). Our priorities during triage:
- Confirm whether connection-pool heuristic toggle reduces p95 within the test window.
- Exchange sampled traces (we’ve attached a short extracted log file).
- If mitigation restores <150ms p95, agree to hold and monitor for 6 hours before full rollback.
- If not, plan rollback window and customer comms cadence.

Jordan / Vivek — post-call please update the RED-9123 ticket with agreed times and the escalation lead contact info. Jordan: please own post-mortem and customer RCA coordination.

Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3cMUTUALPLAN
Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-9123

— Marissa

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Trevor Miles <trevor@bridgenet.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BridgeNet connector — production latency regression (mutual action items)

Trevor / Anika — good meeting yesterday, thanks for mobilizing. Follow-ups from our engineering side:

Immediate tech notes (copied into RED-9123):
- We validated the regression correlates to increased handshake retries introduced by the new pooling heuristic. Sample stack trace attached below.
- Action: we request BridgeNet flip the pool_heuristic_enabled flag in prod for the affected region (DC-west) and report p95 after 15m / 30m windows.
- If the flag flip reduces p95 <200ms within 30m, we will hold and monitor; if not, we will request rollback to v2.4.0.

Attachment: (inline) excerpt of 2026-08-29 22:03 UTC trace showing retry loop.

Operational asks for SLA/mutual action plan:
1) Acknowledge receipt of the MOP PDF and indicate acceptance or propose changes by EOD your local time.
2) BridgeNet to provide a dedicated escalation phone line and primary escalation contact for the next 72 hours.
3) BridgeNet to commit to a 4-hour hotfix turnaround for code changes arising from this incident, or a rollback confirmation within 24 hours.

Please confirm items 1–3. Vivek and I will coordinate customer comms and the internal post-mortem.

— Jordan
Staff Engineer, Partner Integrations | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai

From: Trevor Miles <trevor@bridgenet.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anika Voss <anika.voss@modulus.consulting>, support@bridgenet.io
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BridgeNet connector — production latency regression (acceptance & escalation contacts)

Jordan / Marissa —

Confirming BridgeNet accepts the mutual action plan as drafted (redwood-bridgenet-mutual-action-plan-20260830.pdf) with the following commitments:
- Primary escalation lead: Anika Voss (anika.voss@modulus.consulting) — phone: +1 (206) 555-0199.
- Secondary escalation: SRE on duty (support@bridgenet.io).
- Short-term mitigation: we toggled pool_heuristic_enabled in DC-west at 2026-08-31 14:12 UTC. Observed p95 drop from ~380ms to ~140ms within 20 minutes in our telemetry.
- Hotfix SLA: committed 4h turnaround for critical fixes related to this incident for the next 72 hours; if a code hotfix is required and cannot be validated within 4h, we will proceed with rollback within 24h.

We’ll update RED-9123 with telemetry and include the runbook steps we executed. We’ll also provide a short written acknowledgement for your compliance records.

Thanks for the partnership on this — please let us know if you need any further artifacts for audits / SOC notes.

— Trevor
Head of Integrations | BridgeNet
